scripts.start: pnpm images && GH_TOKEN="${GH_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null)}" LUNA_GIT_NAME="${LUNA_GIT_NAME:-$(git config user.name)}" LUNA_GIT_EMAIL="${LUNA_GIT_EMAIL:-$(git config user.email)}" docker compose up -d --build --wait
scripts.dev: docker compose stop machine 2>/dev/null; pnpm images && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter @hardness/machine dev
